# Portfolio: Routing, SEO, Articles & Vanpedia Knowledge Base

## Summary

Transformed the monolithic scroll-based React portfolio into a routed, SEO-optimized single-page application with a cross-linked article system and a Vanpedia vocabulary knowledge base.

## Changes

- **Routing (react-router-dom v7)**: Added BrowserRouter with Routes for `/`, `/articles`, `/articles/:slug`, `/vanpedia`, `/vanpedia/:slug`, plus a 404 fallback to the home page.
- **SEO (react-helmet-async + Seo.tsx)**: Added `HelmetProvider` at the root (`src/main.tsx`) and a reusable `Seo` component that injects `og:title`, `og:description`, `og:image`, `canonical`, Twitter card tags, and JSON-LD structured data (Article / WebPage). Per-page localization via `PortfolioContext` language.
- **Article system**:
  - Added `Article` + `VanpediaTerm` interfaces to `src/types.ts`.
  - Created `src/data/articlesData.ts` with 3 articles (`moodle-migration`, `notelogic-audio`, `biometric-antispoofing`) and 10 Vanpedia terms (`tritone`, `semitone`, `pitch-class`, `minor-triad`, `mysql-deadlock`, `architectural-constraint`, `redis-stream`, `mock-location`, `liveness-detection`, `point-in-polygon`), with relational links via `articleIds`, `relatedTerms`, and `vanpediaTerms`.
  - Added `ArticlesPage` (grid listing), `ArticlePage` (per-article detail with share button + tags), and `ArticleContent` renderer that parses `[[slug]]` markers into clickable `<Link>`s to `/vanpedia/:slug` and renders a "Related Vanpedia Terms" section.
- **Vanpedia**:
  - `VanpediaPage` renders term detail (definition, content, examples, related terms/articles); `VanpediaIndexPage` lists all terms in a grid.
- **Hobby section removal**: Deleted `src/components/Hobby.tsx`, `src/components/InteractiveNoteLogicDemo.tsx`, and `src/utils/audioSynth.ts`. Navbar no longer links to Hobby, and the home page no longer renders it.
- **Navbar**: Switched to `react-router-dom` `Link` components; brand logo links to `/`, CTA button links to `/#contact`. Hash-based section anchors (`/​#about`, `/​#experience`, …) used for home sections.
- **Blog component**: Replaced modal-based reader with direct links to `/articles/:slug`; home Blog section now previews articles from `articlesData`. Added a "View all articles" CTA to `/articles`.
- **BlogModal cleanup**: Deleted `src/components/BlogModal.tsx` and removed the now-unused `blogPostsData` + `BlogPost` type import from `src/data/portfolioData.ts`.
- **Sitemap & robots.txt**: Configured `vite-plugin-sitemap` in `vite.config.ts` with `hostname`, all static + dynamic routes (articles and Vanpedia terms), `generateRobotsTxt`, and a permissive robots policy.
- **index.html SEO**: Enhanced default `<head>` with `og:url`, `og:image`, `twitter:title`/`twitter:description`/`twitter:image`, `<meta name="author">`, `<meta name="theme-color">` for light/dark, and `<link rel="canonical">`.

## Model

Laguna S 2.1 [Poolside]

## Validation

- `npx tsc --noEmit` — passed (no type errors).
- `npm run build` — passed; production build completed in ~7s (dist/index.html, CSS, and JS bundles generated).
